why: A strict-mode error names a value whose type nothing checked: that value is read at the opaque Any, as a value an assertion holds is (design/strict-fixer.md, 2026-10-30), and the error is advice, never a refusal. Possibly absent (TS18048): longName reads the same field through a local, proved; longTag's test gives false where the parent throws on an absent tag, witnessed. Assignability whose only cause is absence (TS2322): isAda keeps the value and the upper-casing, proved; isAdaTag's `?? ""` gives false where the parent throws, witnessed. A member one member of the union declares (TS2339): wide reads it through a local, proved; long tests the tag and gives true for a circle where the parent compares undefined, witnessed. Each unit compares the opaque read with a literal, so the identity guard keeps its lemma. A member no type declares stays refused (escape strict_value_unchecked_own).
